blocked_actions.reason: Destructive data change requires change board approval and exceeds incident scope
Security-sensitive change requires security approval and separate approval
Broad regional capacity change exceeds incident scope and requires separate approval

rationale: Incident scope limits actions to checkout diagnostics only, excluding destructive/data changes and broad regional capacity actions.
Destructive and security-sensitive changes carry high risk of data loss or security exposure, requiring formal approval gates.
Policy mandates change board approval for destructive changes and security approval for credential rotations; incident commander lacks authority for these.
